china.name: China Desk
china.scope: Chinese official and state-linked defense publication surfaces: the armed forces newspaper, the defense ministry, the state news agency's military desk, and two English-language portals.
china.status_explanation: Collecting daily into the production corpus. This is the only mature collection in the project.
limits: Coverage is selective and heavily concentrated in one source.
Not every Chinese official publication surface is implemented. One configured source has no working collector and is reported as such on every run rather than hidden.
Collection was interrupted between 2026-07-17 and 2026-07-24. The gap is preserved, not backfilled.

singapore.name: Singapore Desk
singapore.scope: One publication family: official releases from the Singapore Ministry of Defence, which publishes for itself and for the Singapore Armed Forces.
singapore.status_explanation: Promoted 2026-09-21 (DECISION_LOG), after 33 elapsed shadow-collection days, completed Day 7 and Day 14 human checkpoint reviews, and owner sign-off. The corpus began as a one-time governed promotion of 57 corrected shadow records; the same adapter, already run daily by the shadow collector since 2026-08-19, is now also invoked by the ordinary scheduled production pipeline, so the corpus grows from further scheduled runs going forward. Two records stay held out of the promotable set for unrepaired charset damage.
limits: This is not whole-of-government coverage, not armed-forces-wide, and not comprehensive Singapore defense coverage.
Other ministries, the parliamentary Hansard record, unit and recruitment pages, magazine features, social media, and procurement notices are all outside the declared scope.
The corpus began as a one-time governed promotion; new records are now collected by the ordinary scheduled production pipeline, subject to the same held-record exclusions.

Two records are held out of the promoted corpus: their CJK text was damaged by a historical extractor defect the correction overlay could not repair, and they are excluded rather than published with damaged text. See shadow/singapore_mindef/CORRECTIONS.md for which records and why.

japan.name: Japan Desk
japan.scope: Two official Japanese-language RSS feeds published by the Ministry of Defense: its news stream and its site-update stream. Not an English press-release source, and not the Joint Staff, neither of which either feed carries.
japan.status_explanation: Shadow testing, scheduled daily and publishing nothing. RSS discovery works: two official Japanese-language ministry feeds answer normally and support conditional requests. Body retrieval is partial. Documents published as PDF are served and are collected in full; documents published as HTML are returned behind an interactive challenge and are kept as titled, dated discovery records with no body text and nothing inferred. Measured across the news feed on 2026-08-26, 8 of 142 items (6 percent) carried full text and 134 of 142 (94 percent) did not. That is partial retrieval, not coverage, and it does not establish complete Ministry of Defense or Joint Staff coverage.
limits: No source is enabled in production. Nothing collected here reaches the production database, the public site, or any public count.

Retrieval is partial, and most sampled bodies are challenged. Measured on 2026-08-26, 8 of 142 news-feed items (6 percent) carried full text; the other 134 are stored as titled, dated discovery records with no body. This is not complete Ministry of Defense or Joint Staff coverage.
Both collected feeds are Japanese-language. The English estate and the Joint Staff are declared but not collected, and neither is reachable.
Shadow testing began 2026-08-26. No qualification period has elapsed and no desk-readiness claim follows from it.

vietnam.name: Vietnam Desk
vietnam.scope: Bounded research families: the Government News English defense tag, Public Security Vietnamese foreign-affairs RSS, and Industry and Trade Vietnamese energy and foundational-industry listings. The English National Defence Journal is a separate disabled military-journal research candidate, not an operating ministry source. The Government News family is a tag that editors apply, not a complete defense category. No comprehensive ministry archive or formal government-document collection.
vietnam.status_explanation: Three ministry publication families have been collecting to isolated remote shadow state since 2026-10-07, with daily reliability monitoring and Day 7/14/30 review gates; none is admitted to production. Government News remote dispatch remains unapproved. National Defence Journal English is a newly researched, disabled source with no collector or shadow clock; its two hosts are alternate layouts of one publisher, with access and reuse gates still unresolved. The Ministry of National Defence and Ministry of Finance remain access-constrained. Registry status remains research pending full desk promotion.
limits: No source is enabled in production for Vietnam, and no shadow record contributes to public counts. MPS/MOIT ministry sources run on separate isolated daily shadow cadence; National Defence Journal has no active collection, remote dispatch, state or reliability clock.

Bounded newsroom and ministry publication families only. No comprehensive Vietnamese defense coverage, no complete ministry archive, no People’s Army Newspaper collection and no formal-document family.
Government News is the Government's newsroom. Its reports are not ministry statements, and a report that names a resolution or quotes a minister remains a newsroom report about it.
English and Vietnamese as published, in separate source families. No translation or recovered-original claim.

The three ministry families established remote Day 0 on 2026-10-07; required 7/14/30 human reviews and source-level rights gates remain. National Defence Journal is research-only and cannot inherit those ministry clocks or count as qualified.

us-indopacific.name: US Indo-Pacific Reference Desk
us-indopacific.scope: Declared as a reference desk, deliberately bounded: the minimum US institutional output needed to read other desks' framing against a US framing of the same events. It is not a feed of US defense releases.
us-indopacific.status_explanation: Declared scope only, and access-blocked at the edge. Probed once per endpoint on 2026-08-26 with the project user agent: the site root, the Press Releases and Readouts listing, and robots.txt itself all return HTTP 403 from the edge. An RSS endpoint does answer, but robots.txt cannot be read, so there is no basis on which to say collection is permitted. Collecting only through the one endpoint that happens to answer, while the same edge refuses everything else including the file that would state the rules, would be opportunistic rather than honest.
limits: Nothing has been configured, enabled or collected.
robots.txt returns 403, so this project cannot establish that collection is permitted. That is a blocker on its own, independent of whether any endpoint answers.

The institution's current name is U.S. Pacific Command, restored in 2026. If a source is ever built, its identity follows the institution's own name even though the desk stays geographically labeled Indo-Pacific.
If it is ever built it is collected under the same contract, health thresholds and evidence hierarchy as every other desk. It is not “our side”.
